_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Taking the Tower#000.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#000.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 兵營跟 Aledar 談話。

Taking the Tower#001.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#001.dst: 哦，{u}！嘿！能再見到你跟 Tasim 真好。希望你們沒有背著我跑去太多場冒險！
Taking the Tower#001.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#002.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#002.dst: 你要找 Tasim 的話，他到訓練室去了。他是真的一頭栽進去了，這……也好啦！我們都得變強，才守得住這個行省。
Taking the Tower#002.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#003.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been there to help!
Taking the Tower#003.dst: Tasim 把你們解決掉的那支腐化部隊全講給我聽了。真希望我當時也在場幫得上忙！
Taking the Tower#003.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#004.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#004.dst: ……哦對！既然你來了——我正要去加入 Van 中尉的小隊，要奪回一座被腐化物佔據的塔。你也一起來吧！
Taking the Tower#004.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#005.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#005.dst: 怎麼樣？想不想累積一點真正的戰鬥經驗？花不了多久的。
Taking the Tower#005.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#006.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#006.dst: 太好了。那還等什麼，就是現在！我們走。
Taking the Tower#006.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#007.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Powder Master!
Taking the Tower#007.dst: 哦，等等。我們得先繞一站。跟我去找粉末大師！
Taking the Tower#007.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#009.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#009.dst: 我還會在這裡待一陣子。你改變主意的話跟我說一聲！
Taking the Tower#009.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#010.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#010.dst: 嘿，你回來了！改變主意了嗎？想不想一起去攻打腐化之塔？
Taking the Tower#010.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#011.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#011.dst: 跟著 Aledar 前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的粉末大師。

Taking the Tower#012.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#012.dst: 好，是這樣的。關於我們要攻打的那座塔，我聽到了一件我們可以事先準備的事！
Taking the Tower#012.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#013.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#013.dst: 聽說塔頂那個大傢伙怕 傷害！所以呢，我們就來粉末大師這裡了。
Taking the Tower#013.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#014.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons here, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#014.dst: 你可以在這裡把各種元素粉末塗到武器上，讓武器能打出原本打不出來的傷害類型。
Taking the Tower#014.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#015.src: In this case, you can apply a powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#015.dst: 以這次來說，你可以塗上 粉末，這樣你的武器對付塔裡那些腐化敵人就更有效了！
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#016.dst: 我，呃……沒辦法把整套元素的說明背出來。你想多了解的話，得去兵營找 Ragon 隊長。他有一整套課程！
Taking the Tower#016.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#017.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#017.dst: ……總之——來，拿著這罐元素粉末，去找粉末大師塗上。弄好跟我說一聲！
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#018.dst: 把水元素粉末塗到武器上，然後到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 告訴 Aledar。

Taking the Tower#019.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#019.dst: 粉末塗上去了嗎？很好，那我們可以出發了。
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p} Suburbs- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#020.dst: Van 中尉他們在 {p} 郊區那一片房子旁邊——你進來的時候大概有看到。
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#021.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#021.dst: 你帶路！我就跟在你後面。
Taking the Tower#021.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#022.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#022.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的狂怒之塔附近與 Van 中尉的小隊會合。

Taking the Tower#023.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#023.dst: 啊，Aledar！在這裡看到你真好。跟你一起的這位是？
Taking the Tower#023.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#024.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#024.dst: 這位是 {u}，長官。如果您允許，他們想加入我們的攻堅。
Taking the Tower#024.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#025.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#025.dst: 嗯……我看不出有什麼不可以。人多好辦事，我一向這麼說。
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#026.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#026.dst: 人都到齊的話就可以開始了。計畫是這樣！我們得在塔底清掉一部分敵人，好讓有人能爬到塔頂。
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#027.src: It doesn't matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#027.dst: 誰去做不重要，事情辦成就好。看到機會——就上！
Taking the Tower#027.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#028.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here!| Understood?
Taking the Tower#028.dst: 需要撤退、或是腐化物都清乾淨了，就回到這裡集合！明白了嗎？
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#043.src: Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#043.dst: 很好。好了士兵們，把那座塔奪回來！
Taking the Tower#043.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#031.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#031.dst: 去吧，往塔那邊前進！運氣好的話，我們能把佔據那裡的腐化物清乾淨。
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#032.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.
Taking the Tower#032.dst: 攻打 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的狂怒之塔，擊敗塔頂的怪物。

Taking the Tower#033.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, {u}.
Taking the Tower#033.dst: 好。該來會會這座塔了！我們辦得到的，{u}。
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taking the Tower#034.dst: 到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 向 Van 中尉回報戰果。

Taking the Tower#035.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#035.dst: 我們成功了，把那隻腐化物幹掉了！走，回去把消息告訴 Van 中尉！
Taking the Tower#035.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#036.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#036.dst: 看來大家都回來了。如何？腐化部隊肅清了嗎？
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: They have, lieutenant. {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#037.dst: 肅清了，中尉。{u}和我攻上塔頂，解決了那隻腐化物。
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#038.dst: 幹得好，士兵們！{p} 軍又一場漂亮的勝仗。首領一死，要把剩下的清乾淨應該不會太難。
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#039.dst: 我會把你們今天的戰果向上將回報，士兵們。還有——來，這是你們的酬勞。
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#040.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#040.dst: 你們兩位前途無量。期待日後能與你們並肩作戰！
Taking the Tower#040.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#042.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#042.dst: 剩下的殘兵我們會處理，不必擔心。今天辛苦了，士兵。
Taking the Tower#042.speaker: Lieutenant Van
